# Dalo 1.0 announcement drafts

Dalo 1.0 was [published on 2026-09-26](https://github.com/sebastian-software/dalo/releases/tag/dalo-v1.0.0).
The [1.0 page](../../../site/news/1-0.html) is available at
<https://dalo.sh/news/1-0.html>. The files here are optional drafts, not a
posting schedule. Choose a channel only when there is a useful reason to post
there and time to answer questions. Skipping every draft is fine.

| File | Channel | Angle |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [`linkedin.md`](linkedin.md) | LinkedIn | Team drift, the review gate, and the stability contract |
| [`x-bluesky.md`](x-bluesky.md) | X and Bluesky | Short thread about the release |
| [`mastodon.md`](mastodon.md) | Mastodon | Licensing, telemetry, and limits |
| [`hacker-news.md`](hacker-news.md) | Hacker News | Mechanism and nearby alternatives |
| [`reddit-r-claudeai.md`](reddit-r-claudeai.md) | r/ClaudeAI | Team drift and trust in Claude skills |
| [`reddit-r-chatgptcoding.md`](reddit-r-chatgptcoding.md) | r/ChatGPTCoding | One skill set across agents |
| [`reddit-r-rust.md`](reddit-r-rust.md) | r/rust | Rust implementation and compatibility |
| [`descriptions.md`](descriptions.md) | Package and project listings | Candidate short descriptions |

Before using a draft, check its claims against the published release and
current documentation. Verify its links and install commands, and follow the
destination community's rules. Some drafts contain counts or version claims
that were accurate when written but may have changed. Do not treat the drafts
as already published posts.

Keep the public 1.0 page and its primary release, install, documentation, and
support links accurate. There is no requirement to add a temporary homepage
banner, post to a particular number of channels, or run a timed feedback
campaign. Answer questions where they arise. Turn specific, reproducible
problems into ordinary issues or documentation fixes.
